names.method: 24 manually transcribed screenshot names plus Rotted and Savage from the 16 November PoEDB snapshot. The Rot card opens a tooltip headed Rotted (archive/12, /14, /22 and /27). Recognition preserves both spellings. Planning and effect lookups treat them as the same Fate. Source IDs and SHA-256 identify the catalog evidence. Independent native recognition validation uses a separate holdout.

rewards.status: Historical tooltip transcriptions, including Black Frost, retain their observed kinds and thresholds. Official 3.30.0c equipment replacements and five chase outcomes are available for manual entry. 3.30.0d confirms the two single-orb combos for manual entry. Nine previously checked motif and frame combinations can identify a reward. Ambiguous variants and new reward icons require current tooltip evidence.

freshSources.result: Single Divine Orb and Orb of Annulment combos require two copies each. Only Nightmare of the Depraved Trinity receives Fate empowerment in Abomination and can drop all empowerment rewards. GGG added an area Fate counter and new line breaks in descriptions. Icon identities and counter OCR await capture evidence.

3.30.0c lists five high-tier chase examples, replaces four equipment modifiers and guarantees associated Viscera from extra bosses spawned by Savage, Pestilent and Sadist. Chase kinds, thresholds, exact area levels and icon matches await evidence.

25 Tier 3 Fate references, 146 reward definitions and eight original portraits. Official Hotfix 2 corrections override stale effects. Shared unique icon is ambiguous. No reward kind, threshold, drop rate or observed card is inferred.

3.30.0b Hotfix 3 permits three copies of one Fate: first and third rewards tripled, second ignored. Regular-reward planning added for equal reviewed tiers. Combo scaling, mixed tiers and output tier are not inferred. No native gameplay validation.

Hotfix 2 removes T3 Crowkeeper Culling Strike, reduces Crowkeeper explosions and Wildfire wall damage, and fixes Viscera drops from some Fate-spawned bosses. Historical screenshot transcriptions are preserved; no numeric risk or drop rates inferred.
